content: stablyai/orca GitHub repo is NOT publicly accessible: both anonymous WebFetch of github.com/stablyai/orca and authenticated 'gh api repos/stablyai/orca' return HTTP 404 (2026-11-19). A WebSearch summary claiming public/MIT status was refuted by both direct checks. Orca ACP-client claims must be re-verified from locally unpacked Orca AppImage chunks (app.asar.unpacked/out/main/chunks), not from GitHub source.
